title: Roman Bakery
description: This image is a relatively modern painting depicting what work in an Ancient Roman bakery would have looked like
source: The Miriam and Ira D. Wallach Division of Art, Prints and Photographs: Picture Collection, The New York Public Library. "Roman bakery" The New York Public Library Digital Collections. 1882. https://digitalcollections.nypl.org/items/643e1b30-c5be-012f-d23c-58d385a7bc34
image_alt_text: This image shows three men working in a bakery. One is putting bread into a very large oven, another is holding the tray of loaves for him, and a final is turning a flour mill. The bakery is made entirely of stone, and sketched to depict the hard work they were doing.

title: A Pompeii Bakery
description: This is an image of runes of an ancient bakery discovered in Pompeii. It depicts an oven, and the mills that would have been powered by donkeys to grind grain into flour.
source: Cartwright, Mark. A Pompeii Bakery. 13 Nov. 2012. Penn State Libraries Pictures Collection.
image_alt_text: This image shows the ruins of an ancient bakery. There is a large brick oven in the back that forms an entire wall of the bakery. There are three large stone mills with supports to attach the contraptions that would have turned the donkey's movement into the power that would turn the stones to grind flour.
